packageRules.description: Track only HAProxy LTS branches. Upstream ships LTS on even minors (3.0, 3.2, 3.4, ...) with ~5 years of support; odd minors (3.1, 3.3, ...) are non-LTS and go EOL about a year after release. See https://www.haproxy.org/ for branch status.

A HAProxy minor bump can change SPOP mux behaviour, which the pinned haproxy-python-spoa commit compensates for. Keep those PRs separate from routine patch bumps so the SPOE agent gets tested against the new branch.
Group GitHub Actions bumps into a single PR.
